hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

notAttached added (absent -> {reason}): the entry now states that this CommandLineTool implements no Implementation Profile, with the reason already given in docs/ATTACHMENTS.md (profiles.yaml tier3.reason). Nothing else changes: the process was not attached before and is not attached now (decision Q1 of 2026-11-11).

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-process-profiles/def/process-type/algae-bloom/download-band-sentinel2-product-safe to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/algae-bloom/download-band-sentinel2-product-safe, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/algae-bloom/download-band-sentinel2-product-safe/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

definition: Downloads the Copernicus product from S3 using the Sentinel-2 SAFE manifest.

notAttached.reason: Band retrieval from a SAFE product on S3, returning JPEG 2000. Its Implementation Profile would need a SAFE format, which has no media type, and a format always has one (decision C8 of 2026-11-10): band-retrieval-safe was not created, so this process stays unattached.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: Same operation as the STAC-Item variant (one band of one product) but reading the SAFE archive on S3 with user credentials and a `resolution` selector (10m/20m/60m). openEO has no credential parameters (handled by the back-end) and chooses native resolution per band; choosing another resolution is resample_spatial territory.
